selectedMaster.selection: 首轮目视：左后齿轮窗、偏右人物、黑猫及台面四工具清楚，台脚与地坪完整。仅执行者选定母版，未做用户审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original full-frame opaque 1024x1536 vertical tarot master for The Magician, theme 琥珀机坊 / Amber Clockwork Atelier. Use the attached original only for identity: exactly one elegant black-haired magician in dark robe with ivory sleeves, and exactly one black cat; clear raised and downward directing hands. FOUR unique tools on the worktable, all clearly separate and legible: wand, chalice, sword and pentacle disc. New composition: three-quarter SIDE VIEW inside a sunlit clockwork greenhouse, magician right of center, large amber gear window in left background, dense but orderly plants and brass mechanisms. Cat rests on a dry stable table edge. Main worktable, legs and workshop floor visibly connect and extend to the bottom bleed with physical contact shadows. Palette warm amber, deep forest green, aged brass; refined painterly fantasy tarot art, atmospheric depth, fine narrow celestial gold border. Tool silhouettes must not overlap hands or each other. No second person or cat, no duplicated implement, no cropped essential support, no letters, title, numbers, watermark or logo. Deliver one opaque full-frame master image.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.

NO people or animals may remain, including silhouettes and reflections. Reconstruct the distant environment naturally behind deleted objects. Keep only the distant landscape/architecture and original atmosphere. Do not add a second copy of the support ground. Opaque RGB image. Specific removed connected group: 人物、双手、桌面四工具及黑猫整体；禁止分别漂移工具与手；本主题支撑归属：工作台、台脚、猫卧台沿与地坪一体. Environment ownership details: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。. Highest priority: an EMPTY clean environment, absolutely no protagonists or foreground props. Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture.
